𝟱𝟬 𝗢𝗗𝗜 𝗛𝗨𝗡𝗗𝗥𝗘𝗗𝗦 👑

Virat Kohli's 117 vs New Zealand in the 2023 World Cup semi-final, Wankhede.
It passed Tendulkar's 49. Kohli ended with a record 765 runs in that tournament. 🇮🇳

#Cricket #ViratKohli

facebook.caption:
𝗞𝗼𝗵𝗹𝗶 𝗸𝗮 𝟱𝟬𝘃𝗮 𝗢𝗗𝗜 𝘀𝗵𝗮𝘁𝗮𝗸! 👑

👉 Wankhede, 15 November 2023 – New Zealand ke khilaf 117
👉 Sachin Tendulkar ke 49 shatak ka record tod diya
👉 World Cup 2023 mein record 765 run

Kohli ki sabse badi pari kaunsi lagti hai? Comment karo 👇
